scope: ProjectOS learning candidate/review/canonical project-lineage integrity only; this prerequisite does not claim or complete M5-003.
integrityRules: New governed ProjectOS learning candidates resolve exactly one active Memory project in the same namespace using canonical key, authoritative alias, or validated relational project_id.
Active non-revoked production can_propose grant for projectos-mcpmaster-production is required.
New projectos_outcome review rows bind exact candidateId and canonical projectId lineage.
Canonical ProjectOS persistence revalidates review-to-candidate-to-project-to-grant lineage and fails closed on missing or mismatched lineage.
Existing legacy candidates/reviews are not updated, backfilled, retyped, approved, rejected or promoted by this migration.
This integrity binding does not create execution authority or policy permission.
